verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents multiple open-format export paths - raw event export as JSONL, CSV export from the UI, and the Engage API for user profile data - plus warehouse connectors and a Query API, giving users concrete means to pull all their data out in standard formats. Community commentary even confirms their export policy is great and that users routinely re-export Mixpanel data to their own warehouse, corroborating real-world portability. Missing for 10: independent verification of full data completeness/fidelity in exports, and explicit documentation of a full account deletion/leave-cleanly workflow beyond GDPR deletion APIs.
